content:
A Webb County jury sentenced a defendant identified as Santos to three years of probation for impeding breath, according to the Webb & Zapata District Attorney's Office.

The jury also imposed one year to serve on each count of assault, unlawful restraint, and interference with an emergency call. The charges will run concurrently.

The defendant was taken into custody following the sentencing.

The District Attorney's Office identified the defendant only by the last name Santos in its announcement.

Source: Webb & Zapata District Attorney's Office.
